Algebra 1 · Unit 3: Linear Relationships

Positive and Negative Slope

Classify slopes as positive, negative, zero or undefined, and connect each to the direction of a line.

What you’ll learn

  • Classify a slope as positive, negative, zero or undefined
  • Connect the sign of slope to the direction of a line
  • Explain why a vertical line has undefined slope

The mountain biking connection

Climbing, descending, flat and a vertical drop are the four kinds of slope on a trail profile.

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 1: Slope and Rate of Change

Slope & Linear Relationships Lab

Design trails in the Trail Designer, then learn slope from rise and run, graphs, tables and y = mx + b, with practice at three levels and a no-bikes transfer challenge.

Level
Beginner to Intermediate
Time
45-60 min
  • Interactive lab
  • Guided lessons
  • Practice (24 questions)
  • Transfer challenge (8 questions)

Practises here: Classify a slope as positive, negative, zero or undefined; Connect the sign of slope to the direction of a line; Explain why a vertical line has undefined slope
